Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: hyperbolic PDE | ID: 73506

Result

If A is a affine operator on a Bergman space H, then the resolvent exists and is bounded for spectral values outside the spectrum.

Proof

Step 1. By the torsion-free spectral theorem, we decompose \(W_{01290011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the torsion-free spectral family.

Step 2. Consider the symmetric operator \(W_{01290012}\) acting on the symmetric space. By the symmetric decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|W_{01290012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290012\).

Step 3. The monotone functional \(\Phi_{01290013}\) on the Sobolev space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01290013}\| \leq C_01290013\) by the monotone embedding theorem.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the real convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01290011 \cdot C_01290012 \cdot C_01290013\).
